items.title: Ogunlade Assures Ibarapa East Residents of Inclusive Representation and Empowerment at Grand Finale of Ward Tour
items.summary: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade concluded his ward tour with a message of inclusive representation, empowerment, and direct community engagement for residents across Ibarapa East.
items.imageAlt: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade addressing constituents during the ward tour finale

items.title: Hon. Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade Joins Oyo APC House of Assembly Candidates for PBAT Walk with AlliSoji 2027
items.summary: The APC candidate joined fellow House of Assembly candidates for the PBAT Walk with AlliSoji 2027, reinforcing unity, peace, and a strong 2027 campaign message.

items.title: BABS Media Pays Tribute to Teachers on World Teachers’ Day
items.summary: The message recognised teachers and education personnel across Ibarapa East for their contributions to learning, mentorship and community development.

items.title: Ibarapa East APC Leaders Offer Prayers Following Ogunlade’s Receipt of INEC Nomination Form
items.summary: A submitted report says APC leaders and stakeholders met with Ogunlade following his receipt of an INEC nomination form and offered encouragement ahead of the 2027 election.

items.title: Ogunlade Congratulates Senator Sharafadeen Abiodun Alli on APC Governorship Nomination
items.summary: A congratulatory message attributed to Ogunlade welcomed Senator Alli’s emergence as the APC governorship flag bearer and expressed hopes for peaceful political engagement.
